name: [GILDED SKIES] Dungeon Quest Reborn
desc:
The original Dungeon Quest is back.

Play dungeons solo or with friends, beat bosses for better gear, and trade with other players to make your set stronger.

🎃 Halloween Event 🎃
Collect candy and get limited Halloween gear before it's gone. The event ends shortly after Halloween, so start grinding!

Officially licensed by Voldex.
